display.purpose: Logo and rank reveal only (The Two Moments Rule).

body.purpose: All UI text; condensed technical sans with tabular numerals for data.

shadows.name: modal-float
shadows.purpose: Dialog panels floating above the live 3D arena. The only shadow in the system.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Hover/active state shifts on buttons, tabs, cards.

motion.name: hit-pop
motion.purpose: Hitmarker pop via WAAPI; cancels and replays per hit.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Accent action: start run, resume, begin benchmark.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { font-family: Rajdhani, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; font-size: 19px; color: #00ffd0; background: rgba(0,255,208,0.14); border: 1px solid #00ffd0; border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px 30px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.1s, transform 0.05s; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: rgba(0,255,208,0.24); } .ds-btn-accent:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: Rajdhani, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #8892a6; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #223047; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 22px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.1s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: #00ffd0; }

components.name: Scenario Card
components.description: Menu entry for one training scenario: name, category, description, PB + tier.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #10151f; border: 1px solid #223047; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px 18px; text-align: left; color: #e8eef7; font-family: Rajdhani, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; width: 270px; transition: transform 0.1s, border-color 0.1s; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: #00ffd0; } .ds-card-top { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .ds-card-name { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-card-desc { color: #8892a6; font-size: 15px; margin: 0; } .ds-card-bottom { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; } .ds-card-pb { color: #ffd24a; font-weight: 600; font-size: 15px; } .ds-chip { border: 1px solid #223047; border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 12px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: #8892a6; } .ds-chip-gold { color: #ffd24a; border-color: #ffd24a; }

components.name: Category Tab
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; font-family: Rajdhani, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-tab { background: transparent; border: 1px solid #223047; color: #8892a6; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.06em; padding: 7px 18px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.1s, border-color 0.1s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #e8eef7; border-color: #00ffd0; } .ds-tab-active { color: #061511; background: #00ffd0; border-color: #00ffd0; }

components.name: Number Field
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: Rajdhani, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 17px; color: #e8eef7; background: #151c29; border: 1px solid #223047; border-radius: 8px; padding: 7px 10px; width: 170px; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #00ffd0; }

components.name: Stat Tile
components.css: .ds-stat { background: #151c29; border: 1px solid #223047; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 16px; display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; align-items: center; font-family: Rajdhani, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stat-v { font-size: 22px; font-weight: 700; color: #e8eef7; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-stat-k { font-size: 13px; color: #8892a6; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

narrative.overview: A pro's private practice range after hours: the room is dark, the lights are on the targets, and the only numbers that matter are yours. The interface is a cool, dark shell that stays quiet so the arena, the score, and the rank carry all the energy. Glow is earned light — logo, new PB, rank reveal — never ambience.
keyCharacteristics: Deep cool dark surfaces layered by lightness, not shadow
One electric accent (Forge Cyan) for action and identity; gold reserved for PBs and medals
Condensed technical body type with tabular numerals everywhere data appears
Wide-tracked display type reserved for named moments
Motion conveys state; celebration is rationed to PBs and rank reveals

rules.name: The Earned Light Rule
rules.body: Glow is permitted only on: the logo, the results score, a new-PB badge, and the benchmark rank reveal. Any other glowing element is a bug.

rules.name: The One Border Rule
rules.body: All structural borders are 1px Edge (#223047). Thicker or colored borders signal interactive state, never decoration.

rules.name: The Two Moments Rule
rules.body: Orbitron appears at most twice per screen. If a third element wants it, the hierarchy is wrong.

rules.name: The Three Layers Rule
rules.body: No surface stacks deeper than Panel Raised. A fourth layer means restructure the grouping.

dos: Do keep full-strength Forge Cyan under 10% of any screen.
Do use tabular numerals on every number that can change.
Do route all celebration through the two sanctioned peaks: NEW PB and rank reveal.
Do keep run-critical surfaces free of transition delays.
Do give every interactive element visible hover AND focus-visible states.
donts: Don't ship the generic neon gamer look: RGB gradients, ambient glow, animated backgrounds during runs.
Don't import free-to-play mobile-game energy: confetti-per-action, AMAZING!!! toasts.
Don't flatten into a sterile SaaS dashboard: the results screen is a payoff, not a report.
Don't use gradient text, side-stripe accent borders, or glassmorphism-by-default.
Don't put Orbitron on body text, buttons, labels, or data.
Don't use shadows for hover states or stack surfaces past Panel Raised.
